# JSON AI Studio

> AI-powered JSON workspace. Format, explain, edit, validate, diff and version JSON using natural language. Free, open source, no signup required.

JSON AI Studio lets developers and PMs work with JSON through an AI chat: upload or paste JSON, describe changes in plain English, review every edit as a side-by-side diff, and download valid JSON. It also explains unfamiliar or deeply nested JSON in seconds and keeps a full version history.

## Product
- [JSON AI Studio home](https://jsonaistudio.com/): Overview of the AI JSON formatter, editor, validator and diff tool.
- [Studio app](https://jsonaistudio.com/studio): The interactive workspace — AI chat, JSON tree view and diff viewer.

## Key features
- Explain JSON: plain-English explanation of any JSON structure, however deeply nested.
- Edit JSON with AI: describe changes in natural language; formatting and validity are preserved.
- Review every change: every AI edit is a visual side-by-side diff you accept or reject per change.
- Always valid JSON: syntax is validated after every AI edit, so you never download broken JSON.
- Version history: snapshot your work and restore previous versions anytime.
- Workspaces: log in to organize JSON into named workspaces as tagged documents, each with its own version history and auto-save.
- Large files: built to open and edit large API payloads and configuration files.
